title: Democratizing AI for all traders
author: SeanM26
selftext:
Hey everyone!

 Why do hedge funds get all the access to the best research and data? We want to change that and have built an app that provides alpha on stock and crypto trades using multi AI models from Opus to Deepseek recreated as a real hedge fund.

I've posted screenshots of the app and it's live now. We just need some beta testers to give feedback and you get access to the free alpha. Sounds like a good trade. We are not selling anything and the app is just for research, there is no money or trades.

I'd love to get folks setup, you can message me here, comment, or ping me on telegram at @.seanm888 (without the period).
